    Race profile

    Story of the day

    Stage 3 of the Tour of Slovenia 2026 featured a three-man breakaway, with Red Bull leading the peloton. The break was caught early on the final climb, resulting in a reduced peloton contesting a sprint finish. Laurence Pithie won the sprint ahead of Cobo and Oldani.
